scope_note_zh: 首期一百天交付框架：工作包、退出门、采购主题与监测窗。cost_class 为相对投入量级（light/medium/heavy），不是造价估算——绝对造价须待权属、现状建筑与市政条件确认后由专业造价团队测算。全部内容为概念建议，不构成实施承诺、采购承诺或投资承诺。
scope_note_en: First-100-days delivery frame: work packages, exit gates, procurement themes and monitoring windows. cost_class is a relative effort magnitude (light/medium/heavy), not a cost estimate — absolute costs must be priced by a professional cost team once title, existing-building and utility conditions are confirmed. Everything here is a conceptual proposal, not a delivery, procurement or investment commitment.

work_packages.name_zh: 令牌台账与首个预约窗口试运行
work_packages.name_en: Token ledger and first booking-window pilot
work_packages.precondition_zh: 线路运营方与场景准入委员会组建完成（G0）
work_packages.precondition_en: Line Operator and Scenario Admission Panel constituted (G0)
work_packages.evidence_zh: 公开的预约记录与归还台账；首窗审计记录
work_packages.evidence_en: Public booking record and return ledger; first-window audit record

work_packages.name_zh: 主线慢行贯通性排查与临时导行
work_packages.name_en: Spine walk-through continuity audit and temporary wayfinding
work_packages.precondition_zh: 现状踏勘许可；无障碍与消防专业复核同步启动（G2）
work_packages.precondition_en: Site-walk permission; step-free and fire-egress professional review started in parallel (G2)
work_packages.evidence_zh: 贯通性断点清单（对 step_free_continuity_breaks 指标供数）
work_packages.evidence_en: Continuity break list (feeds the step_free_continuity_breaks metric)

work_packages.name_zh: 到发场站前广场临时开放（轻量设施与活动日）
work_packages.name_en: Arrival Yard plaza temporary opening (light fittings and event days)
work_packages.precondition_zh: 场地使用协调完成；不涉建筑主体与征拆
work_packages.precondition_en: Site-use coordination complete; no structural work, no expropriation
work_packages.evidence_zh: 开放日记录与人流观察记录
work_packages.evidence_en: Opening-day record and footfall observation record

work_packages.name_zh: 产业展示界面首展与既有建筑改造前置评估
work_packages.name_en: First industry-display frontage and pre-assessment of existing buildings
work_packages.precondition_zh: 权属与现状建筑资料取得（缺则触发 G1 暂停本包）
work_packages.precondition_en: Title and existing-building data obtained (missing data triggers G1 pause for this package)
work_packages.evidence_zh: 改造前置评估报告；13 处更新抓手中 S1 段建筑的逐栋条件记录
work_packages.evidence_en: Pre-assessment report; per-building condition records for the S1 renewal handles

work_packages.name_zh: 到达板与识别系统首装
work_packages.name_en: First installation of the arrival board and identity system
work_packages.precondition_zh: 识别系统规范（图 12）评审通过
work_packages.evidence_zh: 安装验收记录；双语与无障碍标识核查单
work_packages.evidence_en: Installation acceptance record; bilingual and accessibility signage checklist

work_packages.name_zh: 零公里碑与发布厅临时馆
work_packages.name_en: Zero-kilometre marker and pop-up release hall
work_packages.precondition_zh: 站台广场用地协调完成；构筑物为可逆轻量装配
work_packages.precondition_en: Platform-plaza site coordination complete; structures reversible and light-assembled
work_packages.evidence_zh: 可逆性核查单（拆除即可恢复原状）；安装验收记录
work_packages.evidence_en: Reversibility checklist (removal restores prior state); installation acceptance record

work_packages.name_zh: 首场开源发布日（复用已完成场景窗口）
work_packages.name_en: First open-source release day (reusing completed scenario windows)
work_packages.precondition_zh: 场景卡 02/03/05 的已完成窗口证据在案；WP-L1 台账在运行
work_packages.precondition_en: Completed-window evidence of scenario cards 02/03/05 on file; WP-L1 ledger operating
work_packages.evidence_zh: 发布日记录；预约达成情况（对 booked_window_utilisation_ratio 供数）

work_packages.name_zh: 零公里站四象限步行连通预检
work_packages.precondition_zh: 跨越方式与净空的交通市政专业复核意见取得（G2）
work_packages.precondition_en: Transport/utility professional review of crossings and clearances obtained (G2)
work_packages.evidence_zh: 四象限连通预检单（对 step_free_continuity_breaks 供数）

work_packages.name_zh: 编组场地景一期：草甸整理与安全围护
work_packages.name_en: Marshalling-yard landscape phase 1: meadow clearing and safety enclosure
work_packages.precondition_zh: 场地污染与轨道设施安全排查完成（不通过则触发 G2）
work_packages.precondition_en: Ground-contamination and rail-fixture safety screen complete (failure triggers G2)
work_packages.evidence_zh: 排查报告与围护验收记录
work_packages.evidence_en: Screening report and enclosure acceptance record

work_packages.name_zh: 工程测试场地准入条件编制
work_packages.name_en: Drafting admission conditions for the engineering test ground
work_packages.precondition_zh: 场景准入委员会在运行（G0）；数据边界模板评审通过
work_packages.precondition_en: Scenario Admission Panel operating (G0); data-boundary template reviewed
work_packages.evidence_zh: 准入条件文本与首批受理记录（对 scenario_admission_turnaround_days 供数）
work_packages.evidence_en: Admission-condition text and first intake records (feeds scenario_admission_turnaround_days)

exit_gates.trigger_zh: 线路运营方或场景准入委员会任一未组建
exit_gates.trigger_en: Either the Line Operator or the Scenario Admission Panel is not constituted
exit_gates.action_zh: 不启动任何工作包；先补治理，再动空间
exit_gates.action_en: No work package starts; governance first, space second

exit_gates.trigger_zh: 官方红线、控规条件或权属资料发布后与本包空间假设抵触
exit_gates.trigger_en: Official redline, regulatory conditions or title data, once released, contradict this package's spatial assumptions
exit_gates.action_zh: 暂停受影响的空间类工作包，按新边界复算后再续——复算，而不是争辩
exit_gates.action_en: Pause the affected spatial packages, recompute against the new boundary, then resume — recompute, do not argue

exit_gates.trigger_zh: 无障碍通路、消防疏散或场地安全复核不通过
exit_gates.trigger_en: Step-free continuity, fire egress or site-safety review fails
exit_gates.action_zh: 相关布设回退至上一可用状态；可逆构筑物按可逆性核查单拆除恢复
exit_gates.action_en: Roll the affected installation back to the last usable state; reversible structures are removed per the reversibility checklist

exit_gates.trigger_zh: 异议超过公示办结时限未处理，或场景越出声明数据边界采集
exit_gates.trigger_en: An objection is unresolved past its published deadline, or a scenario collects beyond its declared data boundary
exit_gates.action_zh: 收回令牌、暂停预约窗口；恢复须经场景准入委员会重审
exit_gates.action_en: Revoke the token and pause booking windows; resumption requires re-review by the Scenario Admission Panel

exit_gates.trigger_zh: 百日期末评估未达成各工作包声明的证据产出清单
exit_gates.trigger_en: The 100-day review finds the declared evidence outputs of the work packages unmet
exit_gates.action_zh: 转入整改或有序退出：可逆设施拆除、场地归还公共使用、台账封存公开
exit_gates.action_en: Move to remediation or orderly exit: reversible fittings removed, sites returned to public use, ledgers sealed and published

procurement_themes.name_zh: 轻量站台构筑物租赁与装配
标识与导视系统制作安装
procurement_themes.name_en: Signage and wayfinding fabrication and installation

procurement_themes.name_zh: 草甸与雨水花园整理养护
procurement_themes.name_en: Meadow and rain-garden clearing and maintenance

procurement_themes.name_zh: 活动与开放日运营服务
无障碍与消防安全评估咨询
数据边界与准入审计服务
公众责任保险与应急预案服务

monitoring_windows.note_zh: 百日期末评估窗：预约达成与准入时效开始记账，供 G4 移交门判定
monitoring_windows.note_en: The 100-day review window: booking utilisation and admission turnaround start accruing, informing gate G4

monitoring_windows.note_zh: 首个完整运营年：无障碍连续性、非数字等效与异议办结时限进入常态监测
monitoring_windows.note_en: First full operating year: step-free continuity, non-digital equivalence and objection resolution enter routine monitoring

monitoring_windows.note_zh: 三年窗：公共使用归还合规率可被完整评估；六项绩效指标全部具备真实数据后回填 metrics.json
monitoring_windows.note_en: Three-year window: public-use return compliance becomes assessable; once all six performance metrics have real data they are backfilled into metrics.json

measurement_note_zh: 本节规定测量方法而非数值：全部基线值为首年实测；恶化规则中的触发参数为治理建议值，正式参数由线路运营方在首年基线发布后与监测窗一并确定。
measurement_note_en: This section fixes measurement methods, not values: all baselines are measured in year one; trigger parameters in the degradation rules are governance proposals, finalised by the Line Operator with the monitoring windows once the year-one baseline is published.

measurement_plans.observation_zh: 预约台账全量记录（WP-L1 证据产出），非抽样：每个发布窗口记发布、预订、完成三个状态
measurement_plans.observation_en: Full booking-ledger census (WP-L1 evidence output), not a sample: each published window records published, booked and completed states
measurement_plans.statistic_zh: 完成窗口数 ÷ 发布窗口数（季度值与滚动四季值并报）
measurement_plans.statistic_en: Completed windows ÷ published windows (quarterly and rolling four-quarter values reported together)
measurement_plans.degradation_zh: 滚动四季值连续两个季度环比下降即触发运营复盘；跌破首年基线的四分之三进入 G4 评估
measurement_plans.degradation_en: Two consecutive quarter-on-quarter declines of the rolling value trigger an operating review; falling below three quarters of the year-one baseline enters gate G4 assessment

measurement_plans.observation_zh: 场景准入委员会受理台账（WP-S6b 证据产出）：每件申请记受理、补件、决定三个时点
measurement_plans.observation_en: Scenario Admission Panel intake ledger (WP-S6b evidence output): each application records intake, supplement and decision timestamps
measurement_plans.statistic_zh: 受理到决定的中位天数（扣除申请方补件等待期，两口径并报）
measurement_plans.statistic_en: Median days from intake to decision (reported both gross and net of applicant supplement time)
measurement_plans.degradation_zh: 中位数连续两个季度超过公示办结时限即触发 G3 治理复核
measurement_plans.degradation_en: Median exceeding the published deadline for two consecutive quarters triggers a G3 governance review

measurement_plans.observation_zh: 主线全程贯通性巡查（WP-L2 断点清单的延续）：全线普查而非抽样，逐断点记位置、成因与责任布设
measurement_plans.observation_en: Full-route spine continuity walk-through (continuing the WP-L2 break list): a census, each break recorded with location, cause and the responsible installation
measurement_plans.sampling_zh: 季度全线普查＋每次新布设验收即查
measurement_plans.sampling_en: Quarterly full-route census plus an inspection at every installation acceptance
measurement_plans.statistic_zh: 现存断点计数（按成因分列：既有环境／布设物／施工临时）
measurement_plans.statistic_en: Open break count, split by cause (pre-existing, installation, temporary works)
measurement_plans.degradation_zh: 任何可归因于布设物的新增断点立即触发 G2：该布设回退至上一可用状态
measurement_plans.degradation_en: Any new break attributable to an installation immediately triggers G2: the installation rolls back to the last usable state

measurement_plans.observation_zh: 准入时逐卡核对非数字等效通道清单，运行窗口内按窗口抽查实测可用性
measurement_plans.observation_en: Per-card non-digital-equivalent checklist verified at admission, availability spot-checked per window during operation
measurement_plans.sampling_zh: 准入全量＋运行期每窗口至少一次抽查
measurement_plans.sampling_en: Census at admission plus at least one spot check per operating window
measurement_plans.statistic_zh: 抽查通过的场景数 ÷ 在运行场景数
measurement_plans.statistic_en: Scenarios passing the spot check ÷ scenarios in operation
measurement_plans.degradation_zh: 任一场景数字通道运行而非数字等效不可用即触发既有停止条件（G3 收回令牌），比率仅作趋势监测
measurement_plans.degradation_en: Any scenario running digitally while its non-digital equivalent is unavailable triggers the existing stop condition (G3 token revocation); the ratio itself is trend monitoring

measurement_plans.observation_zh: 异议台账：每件异议记提出、受理、办结三个时点与公示时限
measurement_plans.observation_en: Objection ledger: each objection records raised, acknowledged and resolved timestamps against its published deadline
measurement_plans.statistic_zh: 逐件办结天数与超期件数（中位数与最大值并报）
measurement_plans.statistic_en: Per-case resolution days and overdue count (median and maximum reported together)
measurement_plans.degradation_zh: 任何一件超过公示时限未办结即触发 G3：收回令牌、暂停预约（既有停止条件的量化接口）
measurement_plans.degradation_en: Any single case unresolved past its published deadline triggers G3 — token revoked, bookings paused (the quantified interface of the existing stop condition)

measurement_plans.observation_zh: 每次预约窗口结束后的归还核查单：按时归还＋场地恢复两项逐项勾验（WP-S4a 可逆性核查单同源）
measurement_plans.observation_en: Per-window return checklist after every booking: on-time return and site restoration verified item by item (same instrument as the WP-S4a reversibility checklist)
measurement_plans.statistic_zh: 两项全过的窗口数 ÷ 已结束窗口数（季度值与累计值并报）
measurement_plans.statistic_en: Windows passing both items ÷ closed windows (quarterly and cumulative values reported together)
measurement_plans.degradation_zh: 滚动四季值连续两个季度下降即触发运营复盘；单窗口逾期未归还即触发既有停止条件
measurement_plans.degradation_en: Two consecutive quarterly declines of the rolling value trigger an operating review; any single overdue return triggers the existing stop condition
